The '''Treasure Chest''' is a special item that can be obtained in several ways. ==Locations== Treasure chests can be found from the following sources: *0.24% chance from a [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chest]] after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 2]]. *3.6% chance from an [[Artifact Trove]]. *0.8% chance from a [[Mystery Box]]. *1.57% chance from a [[Golden Mystery Box]]. *0.3% chance from a [[Spook Fish]] [[Fish Pond]] with a population of at least 9. *One after finding [[Secret Notes#Secret Note #16|Secret Note #16]] and [[Hoes|digging]] at the red "X" depicted in the note. *Received as a guaranteed gold tier reward on the 13th of Winter for the [[SquidFest]] festival. *Randomly obtained from the [[Mayor's Manor#Prize Machine|prize machine]] in the [[Mayor's Manor]] after the player has received 22 prizes. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Leo,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus |dislike=Linus }} ==Bundles== The Treasure Chest is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== The Treasure Chest is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Pirate Hat|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== The Treasure Chest is not used in any [[quests]]. ==Trivia== * If a Treasure Chest is gifted to [[Linus]], he will not accept the gift and will give it back to the player. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.3.27|Can be obtained after finding [[Secret Notes#Secret Note #16|Secret Note #16]].}} {{History|1.4|Added [[Artifact Trove]] as a source. Can now be used in [[Tailoring]]. Can be produced by Fish Ponds.}} {{History|1.6|Now a prize for the [[SquidFest]] festival. Added as possible prize from [[Mystery Box]]es and [[Golden Mystery Box]]es. No longer a universally hated gift; is now disliked by Linus and liked by everyone else. Can now be obtained from the [[Mayor's Manor#Prize Machine|prize machine]].
